skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and position of marketing in agricultural businesses.
Understand the process of implementing marketing towards effective decision-making in agriculture.
Analyze how environmental factors influence marketing decisions.
Understand the nature and methods of making strategic marketing decisions using the STP formula.
Understand the nature and roles of basic marketing tools with the 4Ps formula.
Demonstrate skills in gathering information and analyzing marketing activities at an agricultural business.
Develop awareness of social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility.
